exit_comments: Listening to isolated block chord progressions played by synthesizers is the absolute antithesis of music. Good composers use consonance and dissonance, cultural context/expectations, rhythm (INCLUDING HARMONIC,) instrumentation, and a million other things to manipulate our expectations and create music. A set of pitches and their relationships to one another is akin to colors available to a visual artist. How the composer/artist uses what's available is what matters. It's impossible study chords without music.
